offers_products.reason: Manufactures and sells DURA-BASE composite mats and EPZ grounding systems; mats are offered for rental or purchase.

offers_services.reason: Site access installation, project planning, logistics, and environmental remediation and restoration services; rental of mats.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are utilities, pipeline, energy and construction project operators, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Rents and sells matting to energy, utility, pipeline and construction companies and contractors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes mainly from project-based mat rentals and installations tied to individual projects, not ongoing subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand depends on pipeline, utility and construction project spending, which customers can defer in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Mat rentals and services are project-based but typically modest per order; sales of mat systems are occasional.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes mainly from the manufactured composite mat fleet rented out, plus equipment, rather than staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large utilities, pipeline and energy companies and major contractors; defense trial noted.

asset_heavy.reason: Maintains a large rental fleet of composite mats and manufacturing facilities requiring ongoing capital investment.

notes: Mix of rental and product sales is not stated on the website; judgments rely on the rental model and the energy and utility customer base.
